source_control.bounded_effect: Separate controller-wide instruction registry validation from per-worker bootstrap reads after durable evidence showed primary_source_verifier failing solely because it interpreted the 21-path registry as a requirement to individually read unrelated controls. Keep all 21 exact identities for optimizer validation, but managed workers read manifest + RUN_LIFECYCLE + only role-specific authority paths required by their current prompt/control. CLEAN workers remain forbidden from unrelated role-control bodies.

current_user_pool_override.authority: newest explicit user instruction dated 2026-09-03 JST
current_user_pool_override.stale_19_role_reference_rule: Historical or dormant 19-role references cannot control current membership, coverage, prompt repair or persistence while self_improvement is user-stopped.
current_user_pool_override.phase_transition_rule: Phase 2 uses the then user-enabled pool and never re-enables self_improvement automatically.

controller_registry.rule: Every optimizer invocation reads this manifest first and validates every path/blob identity in central_controls and clean_role_controls before physical scheduler reconciliation or semantic optimization. This registry is controller-wide integrity metadata.

managed_worker_bootstrap.rule: A managed worker reads INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST first, RUN_LIFECYCLE second, then only the authority/control paths explicitly required for that role by its current repository control and bootstrap prompt. Registry membership alone does not make a path a required per-worker read.
managed_worker_bootstrap.role_specific_authority_is_defined_by: current same-role control plus central semantic control named by that role's bootstrap/prompt
managed_worker_bootstrap.missing_file_scope: Emergency fallback is triggered when a path required by that worker's own current bootstrap is missing/unreadable/authority-unverifiable. A registry-wide missing path remains an optimizer control-plane child but does not authorize unrelated workers to read its body.
managed_worker_bootstrap.prompt_alignment: Current managed prompts must reference this manifest and RUN_LIFECYCLE and preserve their embedded emergency fallback; prompts need not enumerate or individually read the full controller registry unless the role itself is automation_optimizer.

clean_boundary.rule: CLEAN workers may use this manifest's path/revision/blob entries as mechanical instruction identity metadata, but must not read or semantically consume unrelated role-control bodies, O/downstream state, or other-worker state/receipts unless their own current clean control explicitly allows sanitized process metadata.

required_instruction_contract.controller_bootstrap_order: automation_optimizer reads this manifest first, then RUN_LIFECYCLE and every central/role registry path below before physical scheduler inspection or optional semantic work.
required_instruction_contract.worker_bootstrap_order: managed worker reads this manifest first, RUN_LIFECYCLE second, then its own role-required authority/control paths only.
required_instruction_contract.missing_or_unreadable_rule: Distinguish transient unreadable from confirmed unexpected 404. No same-run wait/poll/backoff/retry. Confirmed unexpected 404 may be restored only by automation_optimizer/controller from the latest validated same-path historical version when no newer explicit user-authorized deletion exists, with exact readback and manifest refresh. Never invent paths or restore into bachikoljunior-blip/O.

exact_git_blob_identity_rule.definition: Only a complete 40-lowercase-hex same-path Git blob SHA returned by exact Git readback is valid.
exact_git_blob_identity_rule.failure_rule: If a required same-path exact blob identity cannot be obtained within the bounded read contract, fail closed for the affected controller/worker scope with nonempty exact continuation and no acceptance/persistence credit.

validation.persistence_credit_reason: Instruction-scope semantics changed; require fresh complete post-fix boundaries.

durable_failure_evidence.primary_source_verifier_error: required_instruction_contract_not_fully_bootstrapped_this_invocation due to treating 21 registry paths as per-worker mandatory reads

rollback.condition: Correct forward if role-scoped bootstrap cannot reconstruct an explicitly declared authority or if CLEAN/safety/provenance regresses. Do not reinstate a blanket requirement that every worker read unrelated role-control bodies.

Verify primary_source_verifier no longer fails solely because it omitted unrelated registry paths and verify long_horizon reaches its config11 role-local lifecycle witness or emits a narrower role-local blocker. Keep scheduler persistence at 0/2 until a complete current-18 post-fix boundary is valid, then require a second consecutive boundary.
